name: Emergent Humanity
description: Interactive essay and simulations about humanity as an emergent network, grounded in explicit toy models from network science, dynamical systems, and information theory.

methods.getChapters: Return chapter IDs, numbers, titles, subtitles, and insights.
methods.getControls: Return machine-readable controls for a chapter ID.
methods.getStatus: Return a model snapshot, readable status, hint text, and controls for a chapter ID.
methods.operateControl: Click a button or set a slider/switch using its stable control ID.
methods.scrollToChapter: Navigate to a chapter using its stable section ID.

constraints: Visualizations are explicit toy models rather than empirical datasets or scientific proof.
Ambient audio is optional and disabled by default.
Canvas pixels are supplementary; agents should use text, controls, and status output for interpretation.
The main essay uses restored illustrative animations. Deterministic model snapshots are available in the separate quantitative lab, not in the main animation engine.
